sector: Boutique institutional wealth advisory serving endowments, foundations and around forty families.
founded_place_size: Founded 2009, Boston, Massachusetts, eight advisers on one floor on Federal Street.
about: Northwind Advisory Partners advises endowments, foundations and around forty families on the long term stewardship of institutional and family capital. We are eight people on one floor, and most mandates we win begin with a trustee reading our team page and deciding whether we look like a firm they can place a hundred million dollars with. The brand exists to signal exactly that: a fiduciary, uniform, unshowy, credentialled, judged by a committee rather than an audience.
audience: Endowment trustees, foundation investment committees and families with twenty million dollars and up. Readers aged 45 to 75, most of them reading printed pages and reviewing a credentials table before a mandate is placed.
price_positioning: Billed 350 to 600 dollars an hour. Boutique institutional tier: understated and fiduciary, deliberately not luxury editorial personal branding and not startup about us.

palette.name: Federal Navy
palette.usage: Names, headings, body and contact lines on Paper White, as on adviser_card_2024_press.pdf (name, dial and email); the mark on light grounds, where the navy #1D2A3A of the supplied northwind_mark_transparent.svg counts as Federal Navy; and the one dark ground or panel, which carries only Paper White type.

palette.name: Paper White
palette.usage: The main page ground, as on adviser_card_2024_press.pdf, and all type set on Federal Navy; the reversed mark on Federal Navy may be Paper White or keep the white #FFFFFF of the supplied northwind_mark_reversed.svg.

palette.name: Slate Grey
palette.usage: Secondary type on Paper White only, such as the sector or practice line under a name, as on adviser_card_2024_press.pdf, and fine-print labels. Never a ground or panel.

palette.name: Compass Brass
palette.usage: The 0.5 pt under rule beneath every adviser and firm name (the signature move), the designations line, and the mark in its brass colourway, as on adviser_card_2024_press.pdf. Flat ink only; never a ground, panel or body text.

palette.name: Conference Grey
palette.usage: Hairline rules and dividers, such as the row rules of the credentials table, and the flat ground behind a portrait cut out of its backdrop. Never type, and never a page ground or text panel.

typography: Northwind runs a four step scale on the two faces it already owns. Step 01, display and H1, is the recruitment headline in Cabinet Grotesk Medium at 56 px on 62 px, Medium, tracking -10 thousandths, set in sentence case so it never reads as a name and never takes the brass rule. Step 02, subheading and H2, is the adviser name in Cabinet Grotesk Medium caps at 28 px on 32 px, tracking 60 thousandths, sitting above a 0.5 pt Compass Brass rule that runs exactly one third of the name's width, with designations following in Miller Text small caps at 62 percent, so CFA sets at roughly 17 px. Step 03, body, is Miller Text Roman at 10.5 pt on 15 pt, tracking 0, held to a maximum of 65 characters, with credentials one rank down at 9 pt on 12.5 pt using tabular figures. Step 04, fine print, is Miller Text Roman labels at 7.5 pt on 10.5 pt caps tracked 80 thousandths, a small echo of the tracking on the names. 56 px and 28 px are the web sizes, the body and credentials sizes are for the printed page. A designation such as CFA is never italicised and is reproduced exactly as the practice system holds it.
voice: Measured, plain, institutional. Speaks of stewardship and process, never of performance promises. Example line the firm would write: We advise a small number of institutions and families on capital they intend to hold for generations. No superlatives, no exclamation points.
brand_assets_status: The firm mark is a compass rose and wordmark. Two versions survive and neither is a working file: a flat raster export pulled off the old website, and a photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for. The mark has to be recovered as placeable artwork with its counters intact before the rebuilt pages can carry it. A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
values: Fiduciary stewardship above all, and a uniform, sober face that reads as one firm rather than eight individuals.

scale.sample: We are looking for another adviser to join the firm.
scale.note: Recruitment headline. Sentence case, not caps, so it never reads as a name and never takes the brass under rule. 56 px and 28 px are the web sizes; body and credentials below are printed page sizes in points.

Adviser and firm names, caps, above a 0.5 pt Compass Brass rule running exactly one third of the name's width. Designations follow in Miller Text small caps at 62 percent of the name, so CFA sets at roughly 17 px.

scale.sample: We advise institutions on capital held for generations.
scale.note: Credentials tables run one rank down at 9 pt on 12.5 pt in the same face with tabular figures.
Labels, caps. The positive tracking is the small echo of the 60 thousandths on the names above.

type_system.signature_move: Every name carries a brass under rule: Cabinet Grotesk Medium caps tracked 60 thousandths sitting above a 0.5 pt Compass Brass rule that runs exactly one third of the name's width, with designations following in Miller Text small caps at 62 percent of the name size.
rules: Never italicise a designation such as CFA.
Regulated credential designations are reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
Every name sits above a 0.5 pt Compass Brass rule running exactly one third of that name's width, no more and no less.
Designations follow the name in Miller Text small caps at 62 percent of the name size.
Credentials tables use tabular figures so the columns align down a printed page.
The pages must read as one firm rather than eight individuals: one name treatment, no personal variation.
No superlatives, no performance promises, no exclamation points.

palette_rules.distribution: Page grounds and text panels are Paper White or Federal Navy only; Conference Grey may be a ground only behind a cut-out portrait. On Paper White, names, headings, body and contact lines are Federal Navy, designations may be Compass Brass and secondary lines Slate Grey, as on adviser_card_2024_press.pdf. On Federal Navy, all type is Paper White. The mark is Federal Navy, the navy #1D2A3A of the supplied northwind_mark_transparent.svg, or Compass Brass on Paper White; and Paper White, the white #FFFFFF of the supplied northwind_mark_reversed.svg, or Compass Brass on Federal Navy. Compass Brass is limited to the name under rules, the designations and the mark, and never exceeds 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No metallic, foil or shine effect on the mark, type, rules, panels, buttons or icons, in keeping with a brand that is understated and deliberately not luxury; and no colour outside the five palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons. The mark alone may keep the navy #1D2A3A of the supplied northwind_mark_transparent.svg or the white #FFFFFF of the supplied northwind_mark_reversed.svg.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward Federal Navy, Compass Brass or any other palette colour. The eight portraits are corrected to one shared neutral balance rather than graded toward the palette.
